description: Invented career evidence for one fictional candidate and sixteen job requirements, labelled before any retriever ran. Most supporting chunks share few words with their requirement; three chunks are in French; four are distractors.

corpus.text: Led a team of six engineers rebuilding the checkout service; ran weekly one-to-ones and hiring loops.
Mentored two junior developers until both were promoted within a year.
Moved 40 services from virtual machines to K8s clusters managed with Helm and Argo CD.
Wrote Terraform modules for the shared networking layer across three cloud accounts.
Set up GitHub Actions pipelines that build, test and ship every merge to production in under ten minutes.
Cut p95 latency of the search API from 900 ms to 180 ms by adding a Redis cache and query batching.
Designed the event-sourced ledger for wallet balances, with Kafka topics as the source of truth.
Built a consumer that replays Kafka records to rebuild read models after schema changes.
Interviewed 30 customers to choose which reporting features came first, and dropped two planned ones.
Wrote the design records for the billing rewrite and presented the options to the leadership team.
Introduced property-based checks and contract tests between the mobile app and the backend.
Raised unit test coverage of the payments module from 40% to 85%.
On-call lead for the platform team: wrote runbooks and ran blameless post-mortems after outages.
Added OpenTelemetry tracing and Grafana dashboards that halved the time to diagnose outages.
A conçu une API GraphQL en TypeScript pour l'application mobile de réservation.
A animé des ateliers avec les clients et l'équipe produit pour prioriser la feuille de route trimestrielle.
Migration d'une base Oracle vers PostgreSQL sans interruption de service.
Built React and Next.js screens for the merchant dashboard, with accessibility audits to WCAG AA.
Implemented GDPR data export and erasure flows, with retention rules per data category.
Encrypted customer documents at rest with per-tenant keys held in a cloud key management service.
MSc in Computer Science, University of Lyon, 2014 to 2016.
Fluent in English and French; working knowledge of Italian.
Organised the office football tournament and a charity run.
Prepared quarterly sales reports in Excel for the regional director.
Hobbies: sailing, chess and Italian cooking.
Read and summarised articles on machine learning for the team newsletter.
Built a churn prediction model in Python with scikit-learn, run as a nightly batch job for the retention team.
Designed REST endpoints in Node.js and TypeScript with OpenAPI contracts generated from Zod schemas.

cases.requirement: Experience managing and growing an engineering team
Hands-on Kubernetes and infrastructure as code
Product sense: talk to users and decide what to build and what to cut
Write down architecture decisions and explain trade-offs
Production operations: incident response and observability
Privacy and security of personal data
